headline: Record backlog and higher outlook, with fighter funding risk
summary_short: Sales rose 11% y/y to $20.7B and diluted EPS to $7.97 from $6.95; backlog hit a record $292.0B, and 2026 EPS guidance was raised to about $30.35-$30.75.
summary_long: All four segments grew. Business segment operating profit rose $200M on munition ramps at Missiles and Fire Control and higher Aeronautics volume. Free cash flow fell to $3.0B on strong customer receipts in the prior-year quarter. Backlog includes $52.5B from the multi-year PAC-3 MSE award. Guidance now: sales about $80.0B-$82.0B and free cash flow about $7.8B-$8.0B. Costs on the F-35 Lot 20 contract began to exceed current authorization and funding.
confidence_notes: Free cash flow and business segment operating profit are non-GAAP. The company warns results will be negatively impacted in future periods without additional F-35 contractual authorization and funding. Y/y percentages computed from the release's current and prior-year columns.

drivers.explanation: Growth in each of the four business segments, led by Missiles and Fire Control and Aeronautics.
Cash from operations decreased primarily due to higher customer receipts in the third quarter of 2025.
Includes $52.5 billion associated with the multi-year award to produce PAC-3 MSE interceptors.
